scope: Side swaps inside a dish order («a cambio de la A, B», «con A en vez de B», «cambiando la B por A», «a cambio de A») become a kitchen note on the dish instead of extra portions; «dos <plato con opción> una de X y una de Y» expands without a colon; quantity words before a dish are not a customer name
trigger: Real staging chat: «quiero dos mojarras a cambio de la papa salada, papa francesa, dos sopas pequeñas una de ajiaco y una de menudencias, para la cll …». The owner confirmed the meaning: the two dishes take the first side instead of the second, with no separate portion
baselineFindings: The cart got a separate side portion ×2 with a «papa salada» note, two large soups, a third soup, the dish ×2 with the note «papa salada» and «Sopa pequeña ×2 Ajiaco»
The local glossary rewrote «a cambio de la papa salada» to «papa salada» before any swap reading, so the replaced side was lost
parseCompoundOrderMessage took «dos sopas pequeñas» as the customer name
«dos <plato> una de X y una de Y» without a colon was not distributed; «una <plato> de X y una de Y» lost the second line
With an empty cart, a plural dish plus modifiers was treated as a standalone note and answered «¿Qué se te antoja?»
«<plato> sin X y con Y» answered «no manejamos <plato> Y» when Y was not a known side word: the modifier strip swallowed «X y con» and left Y as a dish word
fix: normalizeSideSwapPhrase (whatsapp-kitchen-preference.ts, applied first in applyLocalGlossary) rewrites «con A en vez/en lugar de B», «cambiando la B por A» and «a cambio de la A, B» into «sin B y con A», and «<plato> a cambio de A» (end of item, no comma) into «con A»; side names may contain «de». parseCompoundOrderMessage does not take quantity words or plural food words as a name. expandDistributedVariants picks the attribute owner whose whole name was said (nested names collapse to the longest), adds a no-colon pass and an ellipsis pass for «de» choices whose counts add up. The standalone-note gate lets an empty-cart message through when it starts with a named dish. stripProductModificationNoise stops a modifier at y/con/sin/pero so each modifier is stripped on its own.
